Running now — check Recent activity in a few seconds
Required for the timer to fire on schedule while the TV is idle.
Stops the system from parking TasksKiller in a standby bucket.
Grants the exemption that lets a relaunch start from the background.
This TV has no screen for that setting — use the ADB command below.

Connect with adb connect <tv-ip>:5555, then run whichever block matches how you want the kill to work.

Shizuku (recommended, no root)
Install Shizuku on the TV, then each boot run:
 adb shell sh /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh
Open TasksKiller and choose "Grant Shizuku permission".

Device owner (survives reboots, no root)
On a box with no accounts added:
 adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.thefactor1.taskskiller/.kill.AdminReceiver

Permissions that have no TV settings screen
 adb shell appops set com.thefactor1.taskskiller SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
 adb shell dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +com.thefactor1.taskskiller

Root
Nothing to do — grant TasksKiller root when your superuser app asks.
Only background-process killing is available. Apps with a foreground service — most VPNs — will survive it. Set up Shizuku, device owner or root for a real force-stop.
\"Display over other apps\" is not granted and no privileged method is active, so relaunches may be silently dropped by the system.
